notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics + in-app support). Started with Hosted API POC (embeddings + chat). POC validated quality; scaling/cost pushes them toward Dedicated. Security is the gating factor for Dedicated/VPC.

Key asks from customer:
- SOC2 Type II report (scope: data processing + infra) and timeline for evidence.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning for user access to Redwood Console. Quote: 'We need SAML upfront - no exceptions.'
- Audit logs with retention controls and export (90 days min; legal asking for 1 year for some customers).
- VPC peering or private link to avoid public internet egress; list of egress IPs and latency expectations.
- KMS integration for model keys + ability to rotate keys; optional HSM mention for high-risk workflows.

Commercials: They're price-sensitive; interested in 12-month committed Dedicated with burst. Estimated ARR target 75k-150k. Procurement timeline: end of Q1 2026.

Quotes/voice notes: 'Hosted POC looked strong—the cost delta at 50k requests/month is the blocker.'

Attachments requested: security FAQ, dedicated pricing deck, example DPA, sample network diagram. See linked_drive_docs.

Concise action items (AE/SE):
- Provide Dedicated security architecture doc + VPC network diagram (Priya)
- Send SOC2 summarization + pointer to auditors (Jordan)
- Draft DPA and pricing addendum, include retention SLAs (Legal ops)
additional_context: Customer has EU customers; asks about data residency for EU tenant. Preferred deployment: VPC in us-east-1 initially, possible eu-west-1 later. Strong preference for SAML rather than OIDC for now.
pain_points: Current support flows have 2-3s latency spikes; need 95th pct latency below 300ms for chat. Cost per 1k queries currently 3x what finance expects.
